pdfjs-dist 4.10.38
Vendored from the pdfjs-dist npm package (Mozilla pdf.js), Apache License 2.0.
Only the two minified build files are committed: pdf.min.mjs and
pdf.worker.min.mjs. No package manifest, lockfile or node_modules enters the
tree, matching how the Duke fonts were vendored (ADR-0026, ADR-0033).

Loaded dynamically at the moment a user selects a PDF, never on page load, so
these bytes cost nothing to anyone who does not import a transcript.
